tasks.title: Atomic Counters, Vote Uniqueness and Dense-Rank Maintenance (Migration 08)
key_decisions: fn_increment_card_view replaces the read-modify-write in retail.py, so two concurrent views cannot lose a count
review_votes with UNIQUE (review_id, voter_id) makes a helpful vote idempotent; fn_vote_review_helpful returns ok or duplicate and never double-counts

tasks.title: Curated-Content and User Administration Surface
key_decisions: routers/admin_content.py owns categories, specs, pros/cons, features, USSD codes and user administration, leaving admin.py to devices, brands, rules, ranking and stats
Every mutation reuses the shared WRITE dependency pair (require_admin_write + ADMIN_MUTATION), so a write budget and the audit hook cannot be forgotten on a new route
Pros/cons, features and tips are replaced by converging (insert, update, delete-stale) instead of delete-then-insert: a partial failure can only leave extra rows, never an empty list
Category deletion is a soft deactivate, not a cascade, because device_categories and the curated homepage would lose rows silently
Promoting or deactivating the last active admin is refused with 409 last_admin rather than locking every operator out
Brand and review deletion were added to admin.py: brand delete deactivates (devices.brand_id restricts deletion) and review delete audits before removing the row
follow_ups: The admin surface answers 503 admin_disabled until ADMIN_API_KEY is set; the smoke test accepts 401 or 503 for that reason

tasks.title: Edge Reliability Core: Request IDs, Cache Tiers, Budgets, Idempotency Replay, Kill Switches
key_decisions: core/middleware.py is one pure-ASGI stack: request id echo/generation, error envelope, cache tier (no-store for cards and health, private no-store for me|admin|ai), access logging
Idempotency-Key replays the first stored response through fn_begin_idempotent/fn_complete_idempotent; it is optional unless the path is listed in IDEMPOTENCY_REQUIRED_PATHS
core/ratelimit.py budgets are per-actor fixed windows and are never the correctness control: a limiter failure must not deny a legitimate write
Kill switches gate the promise-making mutation (create card, review, price alert) and never the read of rows that already exist, so stored content and shared links survive a degradation
Features are advertised in GET /api/v1/meta and GET /health/ready so the SPA hides a surface instead of discovering it via 503
/health/ready is registered on both the bare and prefixed paths and reports database + features + detail
follow_ups: The limiter is in-process, so N workers means N times the budget; replace with a shared store before horizontal scaling
Idempotency requires migration 07's tables; without them the middleware fails open

tasks.title: Close the Backend Depth Gaps Found by the Feature Audit
key_decisions: The audit compared every storefront feature against the route table: the five categories, device detail, compare, quiz recommendations, price alerts, shopkeeper cards, AI chat and the admin console were already covered, so only reachable-but-shallow paths were built
GET /admin/devices deliberately carries no implicit is_active filter (the storefront route pins is_active=true), otherwise the console could never find the draft it is about to publish

GET /compare/{session_id} rebuilds the matrix through the current engine instead of replaying a stored snapshot, so a re-opened link cannot contradict live prices, scores or weights; signed-in sessions stay owner-gated while anonymous ones remain capability URLs
Editing a review resets is_approved to false in the same write, so a published rating cannot change behind the moderator's back
/devices/suggest is declared before /devices/{identifier}: FastAPI matches in declaration order and the path parameter would otherwise swallow the literal route

main.py now declares openapi_tags for all ten routers, and /categories/{identifier}/meta is documented again (it was include_in_schema=False) because the frontend's thin-page noindex rule depends on that count
follow_ups: Review edit/delete are owner-gated and only proven through their 401 gate: the QA flow holds an admin key, not a Supabase user JWT, so a real author round trip still needs a signed-in account
The typeahead uses ilike on name and slug; the trigram index serves it, but a dedicated suggest RPC would cut the wildcard cost once the catalog grows

tasks.title: Dynamic Admin Console for Every Catalog Field, Wired to API and Database
tasks.log: main:5c669b4 backend half (child tables on device create, editor feed, QA); main:a82b69e frontend half (frontend/src/admin/**, App.jsx /admin branch)
key_decisions: The console lives at frontend/src/admin/ and is reached through one additive branch in App.jsx: /admin or #/admin/* mounts it, the storefront routes below stay byte-identical, and the only storefront-facing side effect is body[data-page='admin']

Device create is a single POST /admin/devices carrying the root row, specs, scores, categories, pros_cons, features and ussd_codes, so one form submission fills every table a product page reads and a half-created product cannot exist

Device update is a named per-table save chain (row, specs, scores, pros/cons, features, category membership, USSD diff); each step is logged as a chip, so a failure names the table it stopped at instead of leaving the form ambiguous

GET /admin/devices/{id} was added because GET /devices/{identifier} is the storefront view: it hides inactive rows and merges the universal USSD codes, which would have let the editor rewrite codes the device does not own

field metadata lives in frontend/src/admin/fields.js (13 root columns, 40 spec columns in 7 groups, 7 scores, enums, payload builders) and the spec tab diffs those keys against components.schemas.SpecsOut at runtime, so a schema change surfaces as a visible drift notice rather than a silently missing input
Optimistic concurrency is honoured end to end: every root PATCH carries version, a stale version answers 409 version_conflict, and the console reloads the row instead of overwriting
Categories, brands, review moderation, recommendation weights (save blocked unless the seven weights sum to 1.00) and the audit log are all reachable, so no field or table needs hand-written SQL
Analytics counters in the sidebar refresh after any mutation (statsTick), and admin.css is .adm- scoped except two global rules that switch off scroll-snap and the hidden storefront cursor
follow_ups: The console is key-only (X-Admin-Key held in sessionStorage) and there is no per-operator identity, so audit_log.actor is the shared key; add real operator accounts before more than one person edits the catalog
Media is a URL field only: there is no upload endpoint, so images still have to be hosted elsewhere first
PUT /admin/devices/{id}/categories remains one RPC per category, so a 409 on the second category leaves the first applied; add the batch RPC before relying on multi-category edits under contention
The console has no bulk import, duplication or CSV path yet, which matters while seed 05 is unusable

tasks.log: Migration 07 and its rollback committed in main:0f0ba2c; the backend half (rank RPC wiring, holds-aware services) committed in main:e5626ac. 07's first apply was rolled back by SQLSTATE 42601 because fn_sweep_concurrency_state declared a bare data-modifying CTE as LANGUAGE plpgsql. key_decisions: version lives on devices, user_profiles, recommendation_rules and categories only; device_categories is ordered by the RPC and needs no revision of its own
fn_rerank_device returns ok | version_conflict | busy instead of raising, so the API owns HTTP mapping; a no-op placement does not burn a revision

idempotency_requests stores the first result per (actor_scope, operation, key) and replays it; a failed attempt may be retried with the same key
The admin ranking path now calls the RPC and its audit row is written inside the ranking transaction instead of after it
Device and profile PATCH accept an optional version precondition and answer 409 version_conflict instead of silently overwriting
